modalities.evidence: MRI outcomes included activity of left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex
resting state connectivity of right dorsal anterior insula
cognitive task network during cognitive challenge

output.population: 147 participants: 112 patients (adults with episodic migraine) and 35 matched healthy controls, with up to 3 sessions each
output.summary: Multimodal MRI dataset from a randomized trial comparing enhanced mindfulness-based stress reduction with stress management for headache in adults with episodic migraine, plus matched healthy controls. Includes resting state, pain, MSIT and DTI scans.
